question: Lactic acid is mainly found in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Curd**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Lactic acid is produced by the bacterial fermentation of lactose found in milk.
 
• Curd is a dairy product obtained by coagulating milk in a process called curdling.
 
• The bacteria used to make curd are known as lactic acid bacteria (LAB), which convert lactose into lactic acid.
 
• Lactic acid gives curd its characteristic tangy taste and thick texture.
 
• Consumption of curd provides beneficial probiotics that aid in digestion and improve gut health.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fermentation Process**

 
 
• Fermentation is a metabolic process that produces chemical changes in organic substrates through the action of enzymes.
 
• In the context of dairy products, it specifically refers to the conversion of sugars into acids, gases, or alcohol.
 
• Lactic acid fermentation is used in the production of foods like yogurt, cheese, and sourdough bread.
 
 
 
• **Lactic Acid Bacteria (LAB)**
 
 
• LAB are a group of Gram-positive bacteria that produce lactic acid as the major metabolic end product of carbohydrate fermentation.
 
• These bacteria are commonly found in decomposing plants and milk products.
 
• They are used in the food industry for fermentation and as probiotics.
 
 
 
• **Probiotics**
 
 
• Probiotics are live microorganisms that provide health benefits when consumed in adequate amounts.
 
• They help maintain a healthy balance of gut bacteria and can improve digestive health.
 
• Common probiotic foods include yogurt, kefir, sauerkraut, and curd.
 
 
 
• **Nutritional Benefits of Curd**
 
 
• Curd is rich in protein, calcium, vitamin B12, and riboflavin.
 
• It can help improve digestion, boost the immune system, and promote bone health.
 
• Regular consumption of curd is associated with various health benefits, including improved gut health and reduced risk of heart disease.
